overview: Rishikesh's riverside ghats, Ganga aarti and suspension bridges, paired with Mussoorie's cool hill walks and Kempty Falls.
fit: Good for both. Rafting needs older kids (usually 12+ for real rapids); the 10-year-old can try a gentle stretch.
season: March–April and October–November are pleasant. May–June is hot in Rishikesh but nice in Mussoorie. Monsoon brings landslides.
